decisions.reason: Changing the Book a Session destination to a quote page does not alter links from homepage portfolio tiles to the gallery.
The source concerns the separate Book a Session CTA and does not change the homepage Gallery, Pricing, or Services button destinations.
The same source message already introduces the requirement that the quote form match current brand guidelines, and that Event is complete.
The quote-page and Calendly decision does not affect the retained horizontal-scrolling mobile pricing layout.
Creating a quote request page without Calendly does not change the predefined square-footage bundle prices or pricing model.
The destination and scheduling decision has no effect on the video retained in the gallery portfolio.
The new quote-page destination does not change the source or placement policy for client-supplied website imagery.
The requested quote page is a lead-capture form, not a resumption, replacement, or modification of the deferred real-time quote calculator.
The quote-page and Calendly change does not alter the policy for portfolio hover animations.
The source decision does not change the required count or presentation of pricing bundles.
The quote-page destination does not affect the gallery's client-supplied image collection or planned content.
The source decision does not change the homepage hero overlay color, intensity, or visual emphasis.
